integrity: Exact proof and reproducible supporting finite-dimensional checks; numerical samples do not prove the infinite statement; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Sequential detuning-then-ring-size limits only; no uniform joint regime; single local absorber, coherent nearest-neighbor hopping, fixed positive J and gamma; only provisional historical-priority review.
title: Quadratic half-flux leakage and a Bessel survival law for an absorbing quantum ring
